question: When a record forms in UNT, at the EM step, is anything sent out, and if so, does it leave? UNT's text only says EM comes between the gate and the record. Your October definition says the gate passage is itself the record.
decision: The EM step is the gate passage itself. Nothing is sent out and nothing leaves, which is consistent with the accepted record definition of 2025-10-25. No new rule. Records can be undone, slowly. The arrow of time must come from elsewhere.
